C0183.title: Man Sentenced to 8 Months for 712 Malicious Food Delivery Refund Scams
C0183.summary: Xiangcheng prosecutors in Henan disclosed a case in which a man repeatedly complained and claimed compensation after ordering food delivery, citing food safety and product-quality issues; the case was handled as fraud. Public reports show that it involved malicious negative reviews, repeated complaints, and abuse of compensation rules, reflecting risk-control pressure for food delivery platforms and merchants around after-sales compensation, user complaints, and malicious claims. Platforms can combine complaint frequency, compensation outcomes, merchant distribution, and repeated scripts to identify abnormal claim patterns and prevent normal after-sales mechanisms from being professionalized into arbitrage.
